does: Gives the character entity that belongs to a user id: finds the user in the game server and returns its esv::Character's entity, or the null handle.

evidence.says: looks the user up through the server at +0xA8, takes ecs::GetComponent<esv::Character> on the user's entity and returns the handle stored in it
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on (10 of the 14 fight segments), from 2 places
